results.title: SEBI’s move to protect bond investors: Misleading advertisements to be curbed
results.description: Capital markets regulator SEBI is tightening advertising norms for online bond platforms to prevent investors from making hasty decisions. Under the new rules, promotional content must include standardised information regarding specific securities.
